title: MAYOR OWENS ANNOUCES ROAD RECONSTRUCTION PROJECT ON SOLAR STREET
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens announced a road reconstruction and paving project on Solar Street (between Plum and Court Street) beginning October 4, 2026. The project includes a 48-hour closure with daytime traffic restrictions (7 a.m.–7 p.m.) and detours. This represents routine infrastructure maintenance with potential service delivery coordination needs.
